newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to have 3rd mobile licence by spring 98.
newsitem.headline: Spain to have 3rd mobile licence by spring 98.

text.p: The Spanish Development Ministry will award a third mobile telephone licence by spring 1998, a spokesman said on Wednesday.

"According to the calendar of Spanish telecommunications' liberalisation, a third mobile phone licence in 1998 was already included and the Minister has reiterated that he wants it," the spokesman said.
Currently in Spain there are two companies offering mobile telephones -- Telefonica Moviles, a unit of Telefonica de Espana group which has an 80 percent market share, and its only competitor Airtel.
Airtel is owned by Banco Central Hispano, Banco Santander, Airtouch Communications Corp, Endesa, Union Fenosa and others.
